== Clone Army objective pod ==

Cullen playtested and helped design the Light Side ''Clone Wars'' objective [[Hunt For The Droid General / He's A Coward (Virtual Set 21)|Hunt For The Droid General]] as part of a Players Committee design pod with [[Greg Zinn]] and Adam Fletcher. He said the hardest part was making the clones strong enough to see play alongside Jedi.<ref name="aotd">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lmnqre87HWo&t=1595s Star Wars CCG - Holotheatre S4 E22 - Attack of the Designers (full episode)], Star Wars CCG, YouTube (uploaded 19 June 2023), at 26:35. Transcript: [[Holotheatre/Season 4 Episode 22 transcript]].</ref>
